title: Site settings

fields.label: Studio — bio
fields.name: studio_bio
fields.instructions: Intro text on Studio (/about), next to the portrait. Leave empty to keep the default text.

fields.label: Studio — portrait
fields.name: studio_portrait
fields.instructions: Portrait on Studio (/about), portrait format about 4:5. Shown in black & white.

fields.label: Studio — statement (lines)
fields.name: studio_statement
fields.instructions: One line per row. Used twice: as the big headline on Studio (/about) and as the statement block on Home. Default: NO PRESETS. / NO SHORTCUTS. / JUST THE FRAME.

fields.label: Studio — data sheet
fields.name: studio_spec
fields.instructions: Label / value rows on Studio (/about), e.g. Based in / Vienna, Austria. The row labelled "Since" also feeds the year on Home. Leave empty to keep the defaults.

fields.label: Studio — stats
fields.name: studio_stats
fields.instructions: Big figures on Studio (/about), e.g. Projects / 120+.

fields.label: Studio — selected clients
fields.name: studio_clients
fields.instructions: One per line (e.g. SZ Magazin). Shown as a text list on Studio (/about) when no logos are set.

fields.label: Studio — client logos (optional)
fields.name: studio_client_logos
fields.instructions: With logos the About page shows a logo wall instead of the text row. Transparent PNG/SVG works best — logos are shown in greyscale.

fields.label: Home — lede
fields.name: home_hero_lede
fields.instructions: Short editorial paragraph on Home next to the recognition table. Also used as the homepage meta description.

fields.label: Home — recognition table
fields.name: home_honors
fields.instructions: Rows of the recognition table on Home: year, title, source (awards / press).

fields.label: Testimonials
fields.name: home_testimonials
fields.instructions: Quotes shown on Home and on Studio (/about). Write the attribution as "Name — Role, Company"; the part after " — " is set smaller.

fields.label: Enquire — travel dates
fields.name: travel_dates
fields.instructions: Shown in the Travel step of the Enquire form ("On the road …") while dates exist. Dates: 10.–14. September · City: Berlin. Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: Email
fields.name: contact_email
fields.instructions: Shown in the footer, on Enquire and used as the enquiry recipient.

fields.label: Studio location
fields.name: contact_location
fields.instructions: Only printed on the estimate PDF.

fields.label: Footer — coordinates
fields.name: contact_coords
fields.instructions: Location line in the footer of every page. Leave empty for the default (48.2082° N, 16.3738° E).

fields.label: Commercial surcharge
fields.name: commercial_extra
fields.instructions: Added on top of the licence for commercial usage.

fields.label: Add-ons
fields.name: addons
fields.instructions: Optional extras and their price.

fields.label: Sessions (Enquire calculator)
fields.name: price_sessions
fields.instructions: The session cards on Enquire: name, base price, included hours, extra €/h, optional note. Leave empty to use the built-in defaults.

fields.label: FAQ
fields.name: faq
fields.instructions: Accordion under the Enquire calculator.

fields.label: Send mail via SMTP
fields.name: smtp_enable
fields.instructions: Route enquiry emails through an authenticated SMTP server so they actually arrive. Leave off to use the server's default PHP mail().

fields.label: SMTP host
fields.name: smtp_host
fields.instructions: e.g. smtp.gmail.com or your provider's server.

fields.label: Username (full mailbox)
fields.name: smtp_user
fields.instructions: The real mailbox you authenticate with, e.g. hello@raveenthiran.com. For Gmail/Workspace use a 16-char App Password below.

fields.label: Password / App Password
fields.name: smtp_pass
fields.instructions: Or, more securely, define RVN_SMTP_PASS in wp-config.php and leave this blank.

fields.label: From address
fields.name: smtp_from
fields.instructions: The visible sender. May be a verified alias of the mailbox above. Defaults to the username.

fields.label: GitHub deploy token
fields.name: deploy_gh_token
fields.instructions: Fine-grained GitHub token with Actions: Read & write on the site repo. Powers the “Publish changes now” button in Site Control. Stored in the database — leave blank to hide the button.

fields.label: Repository (owner/name)
fields.name: deploy_repo
fields.instructions: Usually leave as-is.

fields.label: Branch
fields.name: deploy_branch
fields.instructions: The branch the deploy workflow runs on.

fields.label: Workflow file
fields.name: deploy_workflow
fields.instructions: The GitHub Actions workflow filename.

fields.label: Turnstile site key
fields.name: turnstile_site
fields.instructions: Cloudflare Turnstile — a no-puzzle spam shield for the enquiry form. Create a widget at dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile. The site key is public; paste it here to switch protection on. Leave both blank to keep just the honeypot.

fields.label: Turnstile secret key
fields.name: turnstile_secret
fields.instructions: Kept server-side (never exposed to the frontend). Or define RVN_TURNSTILE_SECRET in wp-config.php and leave this blank.

description: Editable site content for the headless frontend: Studio bio, contact, price calculator and FAQ.
